brief: @buildthis.bisks.net make an extremely technically intense and overly feature rich deck board calculator that will mostly confuse the user so I can recommend it to customers in Home Depot
note: built deckulator: 42 inputs, a joist-span advisory, a hygroscopic equilibrium model, and a quantum board-packing optimizer, all to tell you how many boards to buy. deploy it on the sales floor at your own risk.
